description.p: Callie is a calendar for people who live in their calendar. It connects to Google Calendar and any CalDAV server, and gives you day, week, month and agenda views that are quick to read and quick to change.

ul.li: Day, week, month and agenda views
Drag to reschedule, drag to create
Desktop notifications with one-click join for video calls
A companion command-line interface for power users

description.p: Change events as well as create them: edit times, repeats (custom ones too), places with search and maps, guests from your contacts and video calls, move whole series, and undo any change. Changes made offline wait and go once you are back.
Also new: search, an invitations tray, keyboard shortcuts with an optional vi mode, your own calendar names and colors, account photos, the callie command for more tasks, and developer settings.
The first release: a cozy calendar for Linux that keeps up with your Google calendars, with day, week, month and agenda views, quick add, invitations, themes and settings.
